## About
Carriere HVAC-Electric Inc. handles generator, air conditioning, heating and electrical work for homes across the greater Katy-Houston area. We install, maintain and repair, and we work on all brands.
We were originally located in the Boston area before setting up here in Katy. Whether you need a new generator, a new system, routine maintenance or emergency repair service, give us a call.
Homeowners have rated us 4.8 on Google across 144 reviews.

## Services
- Whole house Generac: Mike and the team put in whole house Generac systems for homes here.
- Generator annual maintenance: Yearly maintenance visits for whole house generators, with clear communication about the work.
- Diagnosis and check-up: Straightforward pricing that starts with a $99 diagnosis or check-up fee. ($99 Diagnosis Fee/Check-up Fee)
- Installations with a load calculation: We do a load calculation on every installation so the equipment is sized properly for your house.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my brand of equipment?
A: Yes. We work on all brands.

Q: Do you offer free estimates?
A: Yes, for installations and replacements.

Q: Is there a diagnosis fee?
A: Yes. Our pricing starts with a $99 diagnosis or check-up fee.

Q: What area do you serve?
A: We serve Katy, Houston and the surrounding areas.
